quest.errand.test.yard.title: Test errand: ask the tea house keeper, visit the training yard, read the notice board
shinobi_progression.quest.retry: Spar lost: %s waits at the spar. Hit your partner to try again
shinobi_progression.quest.blocked: %s is blocked: no %s here. It goes on once that is back

shinobi_progression.shop.away: Stand by the shopkeeper to buy
quest.training.test.first_day.title: Training day: spar in the yard, furnish your flat, sleep
quest.training.test.first_day.step.go_ya: Walk east along the street to the training yard
quest.training.test.first_day.step.spar: Spar with your partner in the yard: attack to strike (sneak-attack for a heavy blow)
quest.training.test.first_day.step.shop: Visit the tea house keeper (west end) and buy a furnishing
quest.training.test.first_day.step.furni: Place your furnishing in your flat's main room (3a, upstairs)
quest.training.test.first_day.step.sleep: When night falls, sleep in your bed in flat 3a
